disposition: Staleness modes (allowed/strict with generation bounds) and an IndexStore-level bounded wait_for_non_stale with typed outcomes are implemented and focused-tested at query and index seams. There is no client-visible WaitForNonStaleResults timeout surface on the query request, and the newly-created/side-by-side/deleted index matrix is only partially covered (side-by-side covered at PB-4054).
